checks: Applied supplied fleet-manager SKILL.md, checklist.md and gotchas.md, previously read in this reviewer session; verified relevant facts against f2 snapshots rather than assuming later behavior.

Read f2 target, complete diff, root and fleet-manager AGENTS.md, CONSTITUTION.md, fleet-manager ARCHITECTURE.md, SECURITY.md and PR template; inspected relevant operator documentation and Terraform grants.

Compared changed listing, provider, UI and in-memory store behavior with f2 base. Traced organization discovery through admin authentication, ListPrefixes, validated slugs and LoadConfig; checked sorting, empty results, orphan prefixes and error propagation.

Checked existing AWS ControlList s3:prefix permission and GCP objectListPrefix condition against the unchanged v1/organization= prefix plus delimiter. Reviewed SDK pagination and prefix extraction for S3, GCS and Azure.

Inspected historical cached cloud.google.com/go/storage v1.68.0 reader implementation: this snapshot constructs the default XML-reading client, whose missing-object response returns the direct sentinel; did not report the skill generalization about wrapped GCS errors as a new defect.
Ran GOWORK=off GOPROXY=off with an isolated writable GOCACHE and cached automatic Go 1.27.1: focused TestListOrganizations, TestAdmin, TestOrganization and TestExistingConfig tests passed.
Ran the new organization-prefix/concurrency test with -race: passed.

Ran the new test with a read-only Go overlay substituting the base admin.go implementation: it failed as expected with organization listing scanned the archive, confirming the regression test distinguishes the changed behavior.
Ran node --test tests/*.test.cjs: all three tests passed; node --check src/admin-ui/app.js passed.
Attempted full go test ./src: blocked at TestTelemetryForwardsToTheDeploymentDefaultCollector when httptest could not bind a TCP port under sandbox restrictions.

Full Go suite and make check were not completed: sandbox prevented local httptest listener creation; license checks require network access. Focused relevant tests and race check completed successfully.
No live cloud calls or deployment execution. Provider IAM compatibility and pagination were source-reviewed; cloud behavior was not end-to-end tested.

No routes, grants, stored-record fields, image pins, defaults or protocol fixtures changed. Skipped publishing, defaults, protocol migration and PR-description passes; retained cloud-call/IAM compatibility review because provider list behavior changed.
Browser behavior was inspected through source and syntax checks, without interactive browser testing. No shipper component files changed.
